title: brain is one folder: Sources becomes brain
quote: Rename Sources to brain, and move terms, decisions and sessions into the brain folder too: it is the single source of truth, gated and kept by brain.
means: One brain/ folder holds every doc brain keeps: the sources, terms, decisions and sessions, and by the same reason lessons, metrics and authors. The Sources app becomes brain's app. aip-836d's one migration (its checkpoint 4) moves them.

supersedes.what: The third app is brain's app, holding every doc brain keeps, not only the sources.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-eaaf that held
reflection.result: supersedes d-1ab2 in part (the Sources app); lessons, metrics and authors go into brain/ by the same reason, as aip-836d's thread read "do as you believe is best"
